mapper.sql: c.id, c.document_id, d.knowledge_base_id, c.chunk_index, c.content, c.embedding_json, c.embedding_model, d.original_filename
mapper.select: SELECT FROM document_chunk c INNER JOIN kb_document d ON d.id = c.document_id WHERE d.knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId} AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND d.process_status = 'READY' AND c.embedding_json IS NOT NULL

SELECT FROM document_chunk c INNER JOIN kb_document d ON d.id = c.document_id WHERE c.document_id = #{documentId} AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND d.process_status = 'READY' AND c.embedding_json IS NOT NULL ORDER BY c.chunk_index
mapper.update: UPDATE document_chunk SET vector_index_state = #{state}, vector_indexed_at = CASE WHEN #{state} = 'SYNCED' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE vector_indexed_at END WHERE document_id = #{documentId}
